summary: Builds a linked list of AI opponent candidates. Logs a 'NotAI' debug line, optionally short-circuits through AIPathPerformanceFunction for a2 <= 10, then randomly walks the vehicle roster (modulo the roster count read from a global) selecting candidates. Each accepted candidate gets an 8-byte node (an accessor value plus a float parameter computed by sub_4BF6A0) wrapped in a 12-byte linked-list node that is appended to a head/tail/iter/count list stored on 'this'. After selection the list is counted, split at its midpoint, and the two halves are merge-sorted by the float value at node+4, then the sorted head is written back to 'this'. Returns the number of candidates appended.

operations.description: Initialize the appended-candidate counter to 0.
Reset the list state on 'this' via sub_4BF730 before building.
Format a debug line into the local buffer using the format string from global aSNotNotai ('%s NOT: NotAI') with argument a4.
Report the formatted 'NotAI' message via sub_4C4D50.
When a2 <= 10 and AIPathPerformanceFunction(a2, a3) returns a2, return a2 immediately without building a list.
Read the roster candidate count through ReadFieldAtOffset0x14 applied to global dword_8AC36C and remember it for later loops.
Compute a random starting roster index: 2 * RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() modulo the roster count.
Only build when the roster count is positive and a2 is positive.
Iterate selecting candidates until the appended count reaches a2, advancing the roster index cyclically by 1 modulo the count each iteration.
Pick a candidate vehicle via RandomVehicleSelector at the current roster index.
Fall back to the default name global byte_5EA438 when the candidate slot exposes no name pointer.
Accept the candidate when sub_588410(vehicle name, a3) is true or the roster has fewer than 2 entries.
Allocate an 8-byte candidate node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8), initialized with a NaN float value and 0.0.
Store GuardedListAccessor(roster index) as the candidate node's value field.
Compute the candidate's float parameter with sub_4BF6A0 on the candidate data at offset 188.
Allocate a 12-byte linked-list node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12), holding the candidate node pointer plus next-pointer and active-flag fields.

Append the new list node: when the head at this+0x0 is empty set head and iter to it, otherwise link the current tail's next pointer; then update the tail pointer at this+0x4 and increment the count at this+0xC. The tail's own next pointer is the node-level next field.
Count the list length by walking the node-level next pointers from the head.
Only merge-sort when the counted list length is at least 2.
Split the list into two halves at the midpoint node and sever the link between them.
Merge-sort each half with MergeSortLinkedListByFloat, then merge the two sorted runs by comparing the float value stored at the node pointer target's +4 field.
Write the sorted head back to this+0x0, walk to the last node to set the tail at this+0x4, and reset the iter pointer at this+0x8 to the sorted head.
Return the number of candidates appended during selection.
